# The MSVC toolset of the CppSource builds whose output CI compares: build.yml's oracle job
# (Tools\Oracle and the resource DLLs, compared with the committed vectors and the text
# catalogs) and data.yml's oracle (owner, 2026-11-19; design/reference-build.md section 10,
# "Determinism"). The plain reference build uses the image's default toolset and logs it.
# .github/scripts/msvc-pin.ps1 reads this file, fails when the runner image lacks the version
# and passes it to MSBuild as /p:PlatformToolset and /p:VCToolsVersion. The oracle's
# session.jsonl `env` record (msc_full_ver) shows what a run was built with. None of the
# pinned builds links MFC, which the images do not have for v143.
#
# windows-2025-vs2026 images roll the VS 2026 (v145) toolset forward without notice
# (20261103: 14.51.36231, 20261116: 14.52.37025, neither on the other image). The VS 2022
# toolset 14.44.35207 (v143, VS 2022 17.14, the last VS 2022 release) is installed on both
# and is not updated. To bump: change both lines to a toolset every image in use has
# (the build step lists the installed ones when it fails).
platform-toolset v143
vc-tools 14.44.35207
